Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It tracks tokens starting at `capacity`, refills by elapsed time × rate capped at capacity before each event, advances the timestamp, accepts costs that fit (including zero cost), rejects oversized costs without spending, records per-event balances, and returns the required result without mutating inputs.
